connector.name: Codex Octopus
connector.registryDescription: Spawn multiple specialized Codex agents as MCP servers, each independently configured.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package codex-octopus. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xiaolai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CODEX_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key (leave unset to inherit from parent process)

env.name: CODEX_MODEL
env.description: Model: gpt-5-codex, o3, codex-1, or full ID

env.name: CODEX_APPEND_INSTRUCTIONS
env.description: Additional instructions appended to the default

env.name: CODEX_FACTORY_ONLY
env.description: Set to true to expose only the factory wizard tool
